description: A foreign key to the concept in the concept table associated with the relationship. Relationships are directional, and this field represents the source concept designation.
A foreign key to the concept in the concept table associated with the relationship. Relationships are directional, and this field represents the destination concept designation.
The type of relationship as defined in the relationship table.
This is the measure of mapping precision. Accepted values are exactMatch, broadMatch, narrowMatch
An indicator of a logical group of relationships designed to minimize unnecessary Variable-Value permutations or strictly link several Variables(Events); Accepted values: 1, 2, 3, NULL

Indicator of what library(-ies) and/or tool(s) was/were used to automate mapping. This is typically libraries and reference sets (UMLS, MEDDRA - SNOMED, OHDSI; etc) or tools (USAGI, BuilderRxE, LLM; etc).
This is a number from 0-1 that indicates the strength of the mapping.
This is the indicator of mapping approach with its curation status (controlled/curated or uncontrolled/uncurated)
The initials of the person who performed the mapping.
The initials of the person who performed the review
